sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 将低输入量 iCUT&Tag 应用于 9 科、12 种果实，最低需要约 500 个细胞核。比较呼吸跃变型与非呼吸跃变型果实，发现成熟相关基因激活反复伴随 H3K9ac 富集，而不局限于某一种主导激素体系。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 关键在于克服代谢物丰富的果实组织对染色质分析的干扰，并将跨物种的组蛋白标记与成熟相关基因激活联系起来。SlHDA1 扰动是需要重点阅读的机制证据。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系

papers.title: iCUT&Tag-based pan-fruit epigenomic profiling identifies recurrent H3K9 acetylation enrichment during fleshy fruit ripening

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study applies low-input iCUT&Tag to 12 fruit species from nine families, with input as low as approximately 500 nuclei. In both climacteric and non-climacteric systems, activation of ripening-associated genes repeatedly accompanies H3K9ac enrichment, rather than being restricted to one dominant hormonal system.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The key methodological step is overcoming interference from metabolite-rich fruit tissues and linking chromatin profiles to ripening-associated gene activation across species. SlHDA1 perturbation is a particularly important component of the mechanistic evidence to examine.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This is a direct reference for asking whether contrasting ripening systems share chromatin-level regulation. The pepper atlas already includes H3K27ac, but H3K9ac and H3K27ac are not interchangeable. The study suggests an additional regulatory layer worth testing beyond the four histone marks currently profiled.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: first test H3K9ac at a few key pericarp stages and compare it with H3K27ac and RNA changes before extending to more tissues. Developmental stages and orthologs must be aligned explicitly before cross-tissue or cross-species comparisons.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: A recurring association across species does not establish a shared causal mechanism in all species. The original digest was based on searchable information and a user-supplied abstract; figures and supplementary materials were not fully checked.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Examine nucleus isolation and measures against metabolite interference, stage and ortholog matching, and how SlHDA1 perturbation supports a mechanistic connection between acetylation and ripening.

papers.novelty: SunTag-NOVA 将 TRBIP1、甲基化编辑模块与 CHLAMY 结合，旨在提高靶向甲基化效果并缓解脱靶和发育缺陷。
papers.reading: 重点看靶位点选择、全基因组脱靶评估与遗传稳定性。
papers.relevance: 为 22 组织图谱中的候选 DMR 提供位点因果验证思路：不改变 DNA 序列，检验甲基化是否足以改变表达。

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 作者构建 SunTag-NOVA，将染色质相关因子 TRBIP1、甲基化编辑模块与 CHLAMY 结合。关键不只是提高靶向甲基化效率，还包括缓解直接融合方案伴随的广泛脱靶甲基化和发育缺陷。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 方法的价值在于将位点甲基化编辑与染色质相关因子结合，并同时考虑效率和特异性。是否真正改进编辑，需要结合靶位点效果、全基因组脱靶和发育表型共同判断。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 对 22 组织图谱筛出的候选 DMR，它提供一种验证思路：在不改变 DNA 序列的情况下，检验某个位点甲基化变化是否足以改变表达，而不是仅依赖 WGBS–RNA 相关性。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 研究启示：可把表达变化清晰、区域定义明确的候选 DMR 排为后续因果验证对象。需要将局部甲基化、邻近基因表达与脱靶评估一起纳入设计；这属于后续实验思路，不是辣椒中已有的验证结果。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 目前主要是拟南芥验证，不能假定可直接移植到辣椒。另外，这是安装甲基化的方法，不能替代对主动去甲基化过程的研究。该研究尚未同行评议，原周报未完成全文及补充材料核验。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: 靶位点选择、全基因组脱靶评估和编辑效果的遗传稳定性。优先思考如何为关键 DMR 建立有对照的因果实验。

papers.title: Chromatin-Assisted Targeting Enables Precise DNA Methylation Editing in Plants

en.heading: From DMR associations to locus-specific causal tests

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The authors develop SunTag-NOVA by combining the chromatin-associated factor TRBIP1, a methylation-editing module and CHLAMY. The reported advance concerns both targeted methylation efficiency and mitigation of widespread off-target methylation and developmental defects associated with direct-fusion designs.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The approach links locus-specific methylation editing to chromatin-associated factors while considering efficiency and specificity together. Target-site effects, genome-wide off-target profiles and developmental phenotypes should all inform the assessment.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: For candidate DMRs from the 22-tissue atlas, this suggests a way to ask whether methylation at a particular locus is sufficient to change expression without changing the underlying DNA sequence, rather than relying only on WGBS–RNA correlations.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: prioritize clearly defined DMRs with interpretable expression changes for future causal tests. Measure local methylation, nearby gene expression and off-target effects together. This is a proposed experiment, not a result already demonstrated in pepper.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: Validation is mainly in Arabidopsis, so direct transfer to pepper cannot be assumed. This method installs methylation and does not replace studies of active demethylation. The work is a preprint, and the original digest did not fully check the text or supplements.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Focus on target selection, genome-wide off-target assessment and inheritance of editing effects. Consider how to build controlled causal experiments around the atlas’s key DMRs.

papers.limit: 不能直接由这项研究定义辣椒 JMJ 全基因组靶点；主动去除与复制稀释仍需要独立证据区分。

bibliography.title: Removal of seed coat H3K27me3 in Arabidopsis requires noncanonical functions of brassinosteroid receptors

papers.novelty: 种皮发育需要 REF6、ELF6 等主动清除既有 H3K27me3；BRI1 与 BRL3 通过不同的油菜素内酯信号方式参与。
papers.reading: 重点看 JMJ 突变体、BRI1/BRL3 遗传拆分，以及停止 PRC2 沉积为何不足以清除已有标记。
papers.relevance: 可用于解释成熟过程中 H3K27me3 下降并伴随表达激活的基因群；提示同时检查 JMJ、BRI1/BRL3 和 BZR/BES1。

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 证明种皮发育不仅需要停止 PRC2 继续沉积 H3K27me3，还需要 REF6、ELF6 等 JMJ 蛋白主动清除已经存在的 H3K27me3。BRI1 缺失会导致 H3K27me3 异常升高；同时，BRI1 与 BRL3 分别通过非经典和经典油菜素内酯途径参与这一过程。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 在不大量分裂的种皮细胞中，H3K27me3 无法靠复制稀释，因此必须被酶促去除。这为“发育转换时为什么某些 Polycomb 靶基因能够迅速激活”提供了很清晰的解释。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 这与辣椒成熟过程中 K5 类基因由高 H3K27me3 转为低 H3K27me3 并伴随表达激活非常相似。文章提示你不能只检查 PRC2 亚基，还应系统分析辣椒 REF6/ELF6/JMJ13 homologs、BRI1/BRL3、BZR/BES1 的表达、footprint 及候选靶区。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 可以筛选“组织转换时 H3K27me3 下降、ATAC/H3K27ac 上升、但细胞增殖不明显”的基因。这类基因更可能反映主动去甲基化，而非细胞分裂造成的被动稀释。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 文章的局部 H3K27me3 检测和遗传证据较强，但缺少完整的组织特异 H3K27me3 基因组图谱，因此不能直接定义 JMJ 的全基因组靶点。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: JMJ 突变体表型、BRI1/BRL3 遗传拆分，以及作者关于“PRC2 停止沉积并不足以清除既有 H3K27me3”的模型。

papers.title: Removal of seed coat H3K27me3 in Arabidopsis requires noncanonical functions of brassinosteroid receptors

en.heading: Active H3K27me3 removal and the initiation of tissue development

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study reports that seed-coat development requires not only cessation of further PRC2-mediated H3K27me3 deposition, but also active removal of existing H3K27me3 by JMJ proteins including REF6 and ELF6. Loss of BRI1 is associated with elevated H3K27me3, while BRI1 and BRL3 participate through noncanonical and canonical brassinosteroid pathways, respectively.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: In seed-coat cells undergoing limited division, H3K27me3 cannot simply be diluted through replication and must instead be removed enzymatically. This provides an explanation for how some Polycomb targets can be activated during a developmental transition.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This resembles pepper K5 genes that lose H3K27me3 and increase expression during ripening. It motivates examination of pepper REF6/ELF6/JMJ13 homologs, BRI1/BRL3 and BZR/BES1, including their expression, footprints and candidate target regions, rather than considering PRC2 subunits alone.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: identify genes that lose H3K27me3 and gain ATAC/H3K27ac signals during tissue transitions without obvious proliferation. Such patterns may be consistent with active demethylation rather than passive dilution, but the distinction still requires evidence.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The original digest described strong local H3K27me3 and genetic evidence but noted the lack of a complete tissue-specific H3K27me3 genome-wide atlas. The study therefore does not directly define all genomic JMJ targets.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Prioritize JMJ mutant phenotypes, genetic separation of BRI1 and BRL3 functions, and the model explaining why stopping PRC2 deposition alone is insufficient to eliminate pre-existing H3K27me3.

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 系统讨论植物 Fiber-seq 的实验设计与分析陷阱。该技术能在单条长 DNA 分子上同时解析 ACR、核小体定位和内部 TF footprint，而不只是生成群体平均的开放峰。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 关键实践是控制单分子腺嘌呤甲基化水平、测序深度和样本间总体标记率，同时考虑长读段比对偏差、per-fiber 状态推断及差异可及区检测。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 适合作为辣椒 ATAC-seq / TF-footprinting 的正交验证思路，尤其可用于区分同一果实阶段中混合细胞状态造成的“部分开放”与真正的动态 ACR。对重复序列丰富的 Capsicum 基因组也有方法学参考价值。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 这是方法与分析实践方面的预印本。单分子标记率、覆盖深度和比对偏差均可能影响解释；Fiber-seq 与 ATAC-seq 的信号不能直接视为同一种量。

sections.label: 建议优先看

papers.title: Unpacking Chromatin Accessibility with Fiber-seq

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: This work discusses experimental design and analysis pitfalls for plant Fiber-seq. The technique can resolve accessible regions, nucleosome positioning and internal TF footprints along individual long DNA molecules, rather than producing only population-average accessibility peaks.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: Key practices include controlling single-molecule adenine methylation, sequencing depth and overall labeling rates across samples. Long-read mapping bias, per-fiber state inference and differential-accessibility analysis also require attention.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: Fiber-seq could provide orthogonal validation of pepper ATAC-seq and TF-footprinting, particularly when distinguishing mixed cell states within a fruit stage from genuinely changing accessible regions. It is also methodologically relevant to the repeat-rich Capsicum genome.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: select regions with intermediate accessibility or bulk signals that are difficult to interpret and evaluate whether single-molecule validation is worthwhile. Tissue comparisons must consider cell composition and labeling efficiency rather than attributing all signal differences to accessibility changes.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: This is a methods-oriented preprint. Labeling rates, coverage and mapping bias can influence interpretation, and Fiber-seq and ATAC-seq signals should not be treated as equivalent measurements.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Read the quality-control and differential-accessibility sections first, especially labeling controls, single-molecule state definitions and comparisons with population-average measurements.

bibliography.title: Positional grammar of transcription factor binding partitions developmental and stress-response regulation in plants

papers.novelty: 结合 244 个 TF 的保守结合位点、单核可及性、表达与激素响应，提出 TFBS 的位置语法。
papers.reading: 关注不同位置 TFBS 与发育、胁迫响应之间的关系，以及候选基因关联方式。
papers.relevance: 提示将 proximal、distal、intronic 和 CDS 内 footprint 分层分析，改进成熟调控网络与增强子候选排序。

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 联合 244 个 TF 的保守结合位点、单核染色质可及性、细胞类型表达和激素响应数据，提出植物 TFBS 的“位置语法”。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: TSS 附近开放程度本身不能很好预测细胞类型特异表达；远端启动子、内含子和稀有细胞特异 ACR 中的 TFBS 更能解释发育调控。广泛开放的近端 TFBS 则更偏向快速胁迫和激素响应。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 可直接启发辣椒成熟 TF 网络的改进：把 proximal、distal、intronic 和 CDS 内 footprint 分层建模，而不是将所有 ATAC 峰统一归入最近基因。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 研究启示：为 22 组织图谱中的 ACR 增加位置类别与组织特异性注释，并在增强子候选排序时结合这些信息。可以先比较不同类别中的 motif / footprint 分布，再决定是否调整 TF–靶基因关联策略。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 位置与功能的联系不能单独证明某个 ACR 调控某个基因。最近基因分配和 TSS 附近开放程度都不足以建立调控因果关系；移植到辣椒仍需验证。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: 优先看 TFBS 位置分层、细胞类型特异性和发育 / 胁迫响应的分析框架，并据此重新检查 distal / intronic ACR 的注释方式。

papers.title: Positional grammar of transcription factor binding partitions developmental and stress-response regulation in plants

en.heading: TF binding-position grammar in development and stress responses

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study combines conserved binding sites for 244 TFs with single-nucleus accessibility, cell-type expression and hormone-response data to investigate the positional grammar of plant TF binding sites.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: Accessibility close to the TSS alone is a poor predictor of cell-type-specific expression. Binding sites in distal promoters, introns and rare-cell-specific accessible regions are more informative for development, whereas broadly accessible proximal sites are associated more strongly with rapid stress and hormonal responses.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This motivates stratifying proximal, distal, intronic and CDS-associated footprints in the pepper ripening network instead of assigning every accessible peak to its nearest gene.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: annotate atlas ACRs by position and tissue specificity, and incorporate these properties into enhancer-candidate prioritization. First compare motif and footprint distributions across these classes before revising TF–target assignment.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: A relationship between binding-site position and function does not establish that a particular ACR regulates a particular gene. Nearest-gene assignment and TSS accessibility alone are not causal evidence; application to pepper needs validation.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Focus on positional stratification, cell-type specificity and the developmental versus stress-response framework, then revisit distal and intronic ACR annotations.

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study integrates multi-omics data in nitrogen-limited tomato to investigate strigolactones as nitrogen-responsive rhizosphere signals and their potential beneficial functions.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The methodological interest lies in integration across data blocks, selection of response variables and separation of shared from specific signals. The original digest did not provide enough detail to identify a particular modeling algorithm confidently.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: Although it is not a fruit-epigenome study, it is a relevant Solanaceae multi-omics example. It may inform how expression, metabolites and regulatory layers are integrated, particularly the choice of response variables.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: distinguish coordinated changes across omics from signals unique to each layer, rather than selecting relationships solely by correlation when tissue differences dominate. The suitability of the study’s method depends on its data structure and modeling details.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The biological context is nitrogen limitation and rhizosphere signaling, not fruit ripening. Its relevance here is primarily methodological, and its preprint conclusions should not be directly extrapolated to pepper fruit.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Prioritize multi-omics modeling, variable selection and interpretation of shared and specific signals; initially skim the physiological experiments.

papers.title: The SWI/SNF subunit SWI3B functions with the m6A writer complex to establish embryo patterning in Arabidopsis

en.heading: Chromatin remodeling and m6A in embryo patterning

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study reports direct cooperation between the SWI/SNF subunit SWI3B and the m6A writer MTA, connecting developmental transcript methylation and stability with WOX8 and auxin polarity.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The mechanistic significance is the connection between chromatin regulation and post-transcriptional RNA modification. RNA abundance can depend on transcript stability as well as transcription, so accessibility cannot explain every expression change.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This provides a possible cross-layer explanation for fruit-ripening cases in which accessibility changes do not fully account for RNA abundance, and motivates consideration of RNA modification or stability evidence.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: flag genes with discordant ATAC, histone-mark and RNA changes, then treat post-transcriptional regulation as one hypothesis to test. Discordance alone does not demonstrate m6A regulation.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The study concerns Arabidopsis embryos, not pepper fruit, and is a preprint. It is useful mechanistic background but does not establish the same regulatory chain in pepper.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: First understand the SWI3B–MTA interaction and the proposed connections to transcript stability, WOX8 and auxin polarity; a figure-by-figure reading is not yet essential.

en.heading: Integrating the kiwifruit 3D genome with multi-omics

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study combines fruit and leaf Hi-C with ATAC-seq, WGBS, RNA-seq and seven histone marks, including H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K4me1 and H3K4me3. It distinguishes A/B subcompartments, TAD-like domains and loops, reporting subcompartment-rank changes in about 30% of regions while overall structure remains relatively stable.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The methodological focus is integration of chromatin structure and epigenomic features across scales, including definitions and interpretation of active, intermediate and heterochromatin-driven domains.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: The data types closely match the pepper atlas, making the work a useful reference for multi-scale integration, TAD classification, subcompartment changes and figure organization. It is particularly relevant to planned Hi-C analyses.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: establish tissue and stage correspondence between Hi-C and other omics before relating domain classes to accessibility, histone marks and methylation. Data from different stages should not be treated as strictly paired by default.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: Fruit Hi-C and other developmental-stage datasets are not all strictly matched, and much of the evidence remains correlational. Coordinated structural and expression changes alone do not establish causality.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Read the subcompartment, TAD-like domain and fruit-specific gene results, plus the HiCExplorer, Calder and ChromHMM integration methods.

en.heading: CrJAG connects chromatin state to fruit shape

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: CrJAG interacts with MSI-like histone chaperones to maintain accessibility at fruit morphogenesis genes. The Crjag mutant shows reduced ATAC signal and H3K18ac, increased H3K27me3 and repression of the cell-cycle regulator CrAUR2.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The work provides a mechanistic chain beyond an inverse correlation between a histone mark and expression: TF/chaperone complex, chromatin state, target genes and fruit phenotype. Target identification, genetics and pharmacological evidence should be considered together.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This is a useful model for interpreting pepper K5/K8 H3K27me3 clusters and prioritizing candidates with coordinated TF footprints, ATAC, H3K27me3 and expression changes.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: intersect candidate TF target regions with dynamic chromatin regions and prioritize concordant changes across layers for functional tests. The transferable element is the evidence framework, not an assumption that the same mechanism already operates in pepper.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The system is Capsella rubella fruit shape, which differs from pepper ripening in both species and developmental process. Cross-species relevance requires independent validation, and omics intersections do not replace direct regulatory evidence.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Examine how CrJAG direct targets are intersected with ATAC-seq and how pharmacological and genetic tests strengthen the omics associations.

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 显式研究 motif 的间距、方向和协同效应。传统 footprint 分析常把 motif 独立处理，而 TF 组合、方向和核小体尺度间距可能提供更丰富的解释。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 可尝试在辣椒 distal ACRs、H3K27ac-enriched ACRs，以及 NOR / RIN 网络靶区中分析 motif pair、间距和方向，而不只计算单 TF 活性。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 研究启示：先基于现有 ACR 和 motif 结果比较不同组织或状态中的组合模式，并将序列语法分析作为现有网络的补充。直接使用外物种模型做预测前，应评估跨物种适用性。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 模型没有在辣椒或茄科训练，跨物种直接预测需要谨慎；目前也尚未同行评议。模型解释出的组合规律不自动等同于经实验验证的 TF 互作。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: 重点看 motif grammar 方法，尤其是组合 motif 的发现、间距和方向效应，以及模型验证与泛化评估。

papers.title: Sequence-based modeling of plant epigenomes reveals cell-type-specific cis-regulatory grammar

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: PEAgent predicts single-cell accessibility from DNA sequence using more than 355,000 cells and 320 cell types from soybean, maize and rice. The authors identify 243 regulatory-pattern classes, approximately half involving composite motifs.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The analysis explicitly examines motif spacing, orientation and cooperation. Standard footprint analyses often treat motifs independently, whereas combinations and nucleosome-scale spacing may provide richer explanations.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: Pepper distal ACRs, H3K27ac-enriched ACRs and NOR/RIN target regions could be examined for motif pairs, spacing and orientation instead of considering only individual TF activity.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: compare motif combinations across tissues or chromatin states using existing ACRs and motifs, as a complement to the current network. Evaluate cross-species applicability before making direct predictions with an external model.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The model was not trained on pepper or Solanaceae, and the work is a preprint. Learned motif combinations do not automatically establish experimentally validated TF interactions.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Focus on composite-motif discovery, spacing and orientation effects, and model validation and generalization.

papers.heading: Easy-Multiome 联合测量单核 RNA 与 ATAC
papers.limit: 在果实组织的适用性仍需验证。

bibliography.title: Easy-Multiome enables joint profiling of gene expression and chromatin accessibility in single cells

papers.novelty: 在 droplet-based scATAC-seq 前增加原位逆转录，从同一细胞核联合获取 RNA 与 ATAC。
papers.reading: 关注核提取、文库结构、每核 reads、TSS enrichment 与 RNA 检出量。
papers.relevance: 对果皮和胎座的复杂细胞组成有吸引力，可减少分开测量后计算匹配的不确定性。

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 在标准 droplet-based scATAC-seq 前增加一次原位逆转录，即可从同一细胞核联合获得 RNA 与 ATAC；玉米幼苗中分析了超过 20,000 个细胞核，约 90% 的高质量 RNA 核同时具有合格 ATAC 数据。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: 方法的核心是同核联合测量，减少分别测 snRNA-seq 和 snATAC-seq 后再做计算匹配的不确定性。能否用于新组织取决于核质量、文库表现和两个模态的共同质控。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 对辣椒果皮和胎座这类细胞组成复杂的组织很有吸引力，可为 bulk 图谱中难以分辨的细胞类型贡献提供后续研究方向。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 研究启示：若考虑单核扩展，可先选择少数组织试验，关注每核 RNA 与 ATAC 能否同时达标，而不只是单个模态的平均指标。现有 bulk 图谱可用于选择值得进一步解析的阶段。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 这是一篇方法预印本，原周报涉及玉米幼苗验证，并不代表已在辣椒果实组织上建立可靠流程。采用前仍需核提取与组织兼容性验证。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: 重点查看核提取要求、文库结构、每核 reads、TSS enrichment 和 RNA 检出量；等果实组织适用性得到验证后再考虑扩大。

papers.title: Easy-Multiome enables joint profiling of gene expression and chromatin accessibility in single cells

en.heading: Easy-Multiome for joint single-nucleus RNA and ATAC

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The approach adds in situ reverse transcription before standard droplet-based scATAC-seq to measure RNA and ATAC in the same nucleus. In maize seedlings, more than 20,000 nuclei were analyzed, and approximately 90% of high-quality RNA nuclei also had acceptable ATAC data.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The key is joint measurement in the same nucleus, reducing uncertainty from computationally matching separately measured snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq. Applicability depends on nucleus quality, library performance and joint quality control.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This is attractive for heterogeneous pepper pericarp and placenta, providing a possible route to resolve cell-type contributions that bulk profiles cannot distinguish.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: start with a small set of tissues and assess whether both RNA and ATAC pass nucleus-level QC, not just whether one modality looks good on average. Use the bulk atlas to select informative stages.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The reported validation concerns maize seedlings and does not establish a reliable pepper-fruit workflow. Nucleus isolation and tissue compatibility still need testing; the study is a preprint.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Inspect nucleus requirements, library structure, reads per nucleus, TSS enrichment and RNA detection before considering a larger fruit experiment.

bibliography.title: Genic Position and Methylation Context Shape DNA Methylation-Expression Relationships in Rice Internode Development

papers.novelty: 联合连续水稻节间 RNA-seq 与 WGBS，比较不同基因位置和 CG、CHG、CHH context 的表达关系。
papers.reading: 关注区域定义、context-specific 关联及基因分类。
papers.relevance: 提示将 promoter、UTR、CDS、intron 和 downstream 分开建模，并区分 gbM 与 TE-associated genes。

sections.label: 真正的新发现
sections.text: 在连续八个水稻节间区段中联合 RNA-seq 与 WGBS，系统比较 CG、CHG、CHH 在 upstream、gene body、UTR 和 downstream 区域与表达的关系。

sections.label: 机制或方法上的关键点
sections.text: “甲基化等于抑制”过于简单。上游 CG、gene-body CHG / CHH 更常伴随低表达，但上游 CHG / CHH、gene-body CG 和 UTR 甲基化也可以与中高表达共存。

sections.label: 与你的辣椒研究关系
sections.text: 适合用于完善 22 组织图谱中的甲基化分类。不能把 promoter 甲基化、gene-body methylation 和不同 context 的作用统一解释。

sections.label: 对22组织图谱的具体启示
sections.text: 研究启示：在 promoter DMR 之外，分别建立 promoter、UTR、CDS、intron 和 downstream 的 context-specific 模型，并区分 gbM、TE-associated genes 和非 TE genes。

sections.label: 需要注意
sections.text: 主要是关联分析，而且组织梯度包含细胞组成变化，不能直接证明甲基化导致表达改变。该研究尚未同行评议，其关系也不能不加验证地外推到辣椒。

sections.label: 建议优先看
sections.text: 优先看基因区域定义、CG / CHG / CHH 分层、表达关联的统计方法，以及如何区分不同基因类别。

papers.title: Genic Position and Methylation Context Shape DNA Methylation–Expression Relationships in Rice Internode Development

en.heading: Gene position and methylation context in expression associations

sections.label: What is new
sections.text: The study combines RNA-seq and WGBS across eight consecutive rice internode sections to compare CG, CHG and CHH methylation in upstream, gene-body, UTR and downstream regions.

sections.label: Mechanistic or methodological key point
sections.text: The results argue against equating methylation with repression in all contexts. Upstream CG and gene-body CHG/CHH are more often associated with low expression, while upstream CHG/CHH, gene-body CG and UTR methylation can coexist with moderate or high expression.

sections.label: Relevance to pepper research
sections.text: This can inform methylation classification in the 22-tissue atlas. Promoter methylation, gene-body methylation and individual sequence contexts should not be interpreted as a single regulatory category.

sections.label: Implications for the 22-tissue atlas
sections.text: Research proposal: complement promoter DMRs with context-specific models for promoters, UTRs, CDSs, introns and downstream regions, separating gbM, TE-associated and non-TE genes.

sections.label: Limitations
sections.text: The evidence is mainly associative, and the tissue gradient also reflects cell-composition changes. It does not demonstrate that methylation causes expression changes. The study is a preprint, and transfer to pepper needs validation.

sections.label: What to read first
sections.text: Prioritize gene-region definitions, CG/CHG/CHH stratification, statistical association methods and separation of gene classes.
